claim: Monolith Productions was closed by Warner Bros on 2025-02-25, so further patches to Shadow of War are unlikely and build 3095001 is a stable target.
evidence: Bloomberg 2025-02-25: Monolith, Player First Games and WB San Diego shuttered.
game_build_compatibility: Supports treating 1.0.8874.0 / 3095001 as final; coop-anything notes cite last update 2018-09-05 (unverified by us).
verification_method: Multiple news sources agree on the closure.
limitations: WB could still push updates (e.g. DRM or online changes) via Steam; studio closure is not a guarantee.
next_experiment: Pin the build (record Steam buildid/hash before each test session) and disable auto-update for the test copy.
